scope: Animation that carries a subject or action into a new explanatory view; three straight-cut controls prevent misclassifying ordinary edits as continuous transformations.

cases.title: Keep the chosen moon; change its surrounding context
cases.carry: Amalthea remains visible while the title, building and other options recede; the selected object grows/repositions, then shrinks as Jupiter enters.
cases.mechanism: Selective context removal and an animated subject, followed by a scale comparison; not a dissolve between two complete stills.

cases.title: The prop makes room for its consequence
cases.carry: The saffron bowl lifts and tilts while labels retract; the anatomical head rises below it and falling specks connect bowl to brain.
cases.mechanism: Coordinated prop motion, character/diagram entrance and a causal particle path in one shared field.

cases.title: A flapping wing hands its pumping action to bellows
cases.carry: Wing movement continues as a bellows drawing appears at the same working hinge; the illustrated bellows pumps, then moves left along its connecting tube as the lungs enter.
cases.mechanism: Aligned local overlap/replacement, continued deformation, then connected-object reveal. The wing remains partly translucent; footage does not establish a literal topology morph.

cases.title: Reveal the puppet around the molecular control
cases.carry: The green stem and bead shrink toward the puppet's lower body while the larger puppet is revealed and starts articulating.
cases.mechanism: Persistent visual anchor with a reveal of a larger mechanism. Scale movement supports the animated metaphor.

cases.title: An enlarging fiber fills the view before the molecule detail
cases.carry: The orange/yellow fiber grows, its side fills the frame, then the view changes to elongated molecular strands with moving charge symbols.
cases.mechanism: Scale-through occlusion and a detailed replacement drawing. A cut is present at the change of representation; a seamless private 3D scene is not established.

cases.title: An extracted osteon becomes a cell-level explanation
cases.carry: The already raised cylinder enlarges and shifts into the close view; the concentric top is replaced/revealed as the blue cell network while the orange cylinder remains.
cases.mechanism: Object isolation, enlargement and a local diagram change rather than replacing the entire composition.

cases.title: The moving inset becomes the environment
cases.carry: The rainy inset expands past its border; rain continues, water fills the lower view, and a probe enters the same moving environment.
cases.mechanism: Animated contents persist while their viewport opens. Enlarging a frozen preview would lose the key feature.

cases.title: A field grows out from the active brain
cases.carry: The brain changes scale/expression, a small colored field appears around it, and that field rapidly expands to fill the frame while the brain remains identifiable.
cases.mechanism: Subject-led expanding effect with continuing internal band motion, not two whole-frame images crossfading.

cases.title: The projected rebuilding model becomes the working diagram
cases.carry: The same city/construction model enlarges with its turquoise screen field; the frame and presenter move beyond the view and the model continues its building action.
cases.mechanism: Nested composition expands into the next explanatory space. Subject action continues through the scale change.

cases.title: One moving paper becomes the particle explanation
cases.carry: A paper separates from the falling clutter, remains bright as the room dims, enlarges, then hands its particle figure to the colored diagram while the page recedes.
cases.mechanism: Object selection, staged background removal and a local diagram handoff. Selective opacity contributes, but the moving subject connects the views.

cases.title: The working diagram becomes content on a monitor
cases.carry: The same upper/lower particle groups shrink into a monitor as the desk and scientist are revealed; the scientist settles at the screen.
cases.mechanism: Persistent diagram and animated context reveal. The diagram is not removed and replaced by an unrelated room photograph.

cases.title: The energy effect covers the representation change
cases.carry: The luminous central burst grows to near/full white coverage; the yellow/purple matter–antimatter field emerges around the same central energy shape.
cases.mechanism: Action-caused luminous coverage with a shared center. This does not justify adding unmotivated flashes between other subjects.

controls.title: Control: baby scene to neuron diagram
controls.carry: A direct shot change; no observed object travels through this boundary.
controls.mechanism: Ordinary cut. Do not cite this as a continuous zoom or morph.

controls.title: Control: whole Io to volcanic surface
controls.carry: The surface shares the planet's warm subject/palette but the sampled boundary is a direct change of view.
controls.mechanism: Ordinary cut. Similar subject matter is not proof of continuous motion.

controls.title: Control: explosion to kitchen consequence
controls.carry: The explosion is followed by a direct return to the kitchen; it does not visibly reveal the room through an organic wipe.
controls.mechanism: Ordinary cut. Do not label every animated explosion an object-driven transition.

dense.title: 24 consecutive decoded frames: fiber fills frame, molecule detail follows
24 consecutive decoded frames: active inset opens into environment
24 consecutive decoded frames: aligned wing and working bellows
24 consecutive decoded frames: effect expands around the continuing brain
24 consecutive decoded frames: particle diagram becomes monitor content
